name: Warm Mexican Bolillo Bread (Skip Corn Chips & Salsa)
whyItWorks: Mexican bolillo rolls have a pillow-soft white-flour interior that digests cleanly, unlike the sharp corn tortilla chips served alongside them.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat the warm white bolillo bread with plain butter and strictly skip the fried corn tortilla chips and chunky tomato-chili salsa.
watchOuts: Fried corn tortilla chips (sharp corn kernel hulls)
Spicy tomato salsa skins and seeds
